LanguageData.ESCP_MaormerKingdom_Enlist_Letter_Label: The colony now serves King Orgnum. Maormer ships will pay and feed those who sail under the serpent banner.
LanguageData.ESCP_MaormerKingdom_Enlist_Button_Desc: Take service with the Sea Elves of Pyandonea and their ageless king.
LanguageData.ESCP_MaormerKingdom_Enlist_Requrements_N: The Maormer do not trust outsiders, and they do not trust you. Standing: {0}.
LanguageData.ESCP_MaormerKingdom_Enlisted_To_Hostile_: Pyandonea will not take the oath of an enemy.
LanguageData.ESCP_MaormerKingdom_Missions_Desc: See what the fleet needs done.
LanguageData.ESCP_MaormerKingdom_Menu_Missions_Desc: Orders from the Maormer fleet. Paid when done.
LanguageData.ESCP_MaormerKingdom_Provisions_Desc: Salted fish and fresh water from the fleet.
LanguageData.ESCP_MaormerKingdom_Storage_Desc: Leave goods aboard a Maormer ship.
LanguageData.ESCP_MaormerKingdom_Resign_Menu_Text: Leave King Orgnum's service? The Maormer hold grudges for a long time.
LanguageData.ESCP_MaormerKingdom_Resign_Letter_Label: The colony has left the service of King Orgnum.
LanguageData.ESCP_MaormerKingdom_Kick_Out_Label_Title: King Orgnum has no further use for the colony.
LanguageData.ESCP_MaormerKingdom_Work_0_Desc: Crew a Maormer ship along the coast.
LanguageData.ESCP_MaormerKingdom_Work_1_Desc: Learn how the Maormer call and tame sea serpents.
